name: specbridge
description: Turn rough product ideas into repository-grounded, research-backed, implementation-ready system design specifications.

interface.shortDescription: Compile ideas into implementation-ready system specs
interface.longDescription: Use Codex as the conversational frontend for SpecBridge 2.0. Ground designs in the current repository, research uncertain external facts, resolve only material product decisions with the human, evaluate design quality, and compile a portable Spec Pack. Implementation remains entirely outside SpecBridge.
defaultPrompt: Turn this idea into a complete system design spec
